He enjoys walking them outside and shares pics with Joanna, and promised to keep sending turtle pics. Joanna (also newly allergic to cockroaches) wishes she could have two turtles.

On 20 May 2022 Nate shared a photo of Max, a newly adopted pet (energetic). Max fills his life with joy and keeps his other pets active. Joanna still doesn't want a pet because of allergies.

On 25 May 2022 Nate confirmed Max is a dog. While walking Max he met a nice couple with a dog who live nearby; they set up regular doggy playdates and Max loves the other dog. Nate says seeing Max so happy is a dream come true. He also gave Joanna a stuffed animal pup as a reminder of good vibes. On 21 Oct 2022 Joanna said she named it Tilly (after her childhood dog in Michigan she had to give up due to allergies) and keeps it with her while writing.

On 22 Aug 2022 Nate showed Joanna his turtles' new, larger tank; they're calm and peaceful and make coming home after long gaming days better. He planned a weekend off to chill with his pets.

On 21 Oct 2022 Nate said he's stressed by tough tournament competitors but his turtles always cheer him up; he can't explain why watching them walk slowly makes him so happy.

On 25 Oct 2022 Nate said he took his turtles for a walk that day. Their diet is vegetables, fruits and insects; he loves watching them eat fruit (they get hyped). He likes holding them. They have different personalities: one adventurous, one reserved. He has liked turtles since he was a boy.

On 9 Nov 2022 Nate said he got a third turtle from a pet store (the tank is big enough for three). Joanna (allergic) planned to visit 10 Nov 2022 to watch from a distance; he'd bathe the turtles first.

On 10 Nov 2022 Nate took his turtles to the beach in Tampa (suggesting he lives in/near Tampa, Florida); they sunbathed and he calls them zen masters that remind him to slow down.
